panels.scene: Sam at a kitchen counter far away, phone in hand, a mug beside him, morning light. Top third plain wall.
dialogue: What came in the mail this week?
panels.caption: Ask what came.

panels.scene: June at her kitchen table sorting envelopes into two piles with a pen in hand, reading glasses on her head, the small green kettle on the stove.
panels.caption: Let them lead.

panels.scene: June holding up a thick envelope at the table, smiling; Sam on a phone screen-less call is shown as a small figure at his counter smiling back, both relaxed.
dialogue: Want to talk it through together?
panels.caption: Their mail. Their call.
